name: react-three/rapier
category: A9. Adjacent resources mentioned during discovery
role: Rapier physics for R3F as components: bodies, colliders, joints, manual stepping
summary: pmndrs R3F integration of the Rapier WASM physics engine: RigidBody, colliders, joints and instanced bodies as components, with a fixed 60 Hz timestep and a manual step() option. Driven from JSX and refs; output is simulated transforms rendered by R3F. Strength is physics inside the R3F tree with snapshot and restore.
use_when: Physics-driven motion inside an existing R3F scene, stepped by the capture clock
Over raw Rapier when bodies map one-to-one onto R3F meshes
Instanced debris or crowds with colliders in R3F
avoid_when: Non-R3F or non-React scenes: Rapier directly
Seek to arbitrary t: physics is forward-only, bake or use snapshots instead

evidence.result: 90 frames at 1280x720, shuffled order matches sequential (0 mismatched), distinct hashes, frame 45 alpha 0..1; @dimforge/rapier3d-compat 0.19.2, @react-three/fiber 9.8.2, three 0.186.1, react 19.3.1, Playwright 1.64.1, Chromium 156.0.8078.4.
evidence.scope: Paused Rapier world restored from snapshot, stepped 1/60 s per seek; 90 alpha frames, shuffled matches sequential; no joints, events or independent loop; MIT per upstream repo; macOS arm64.

assessment.rationale: v2.2.0 published Nov 2025 (inside 12 months), supports R3F v9 and React 19. Adds R3F-native component API over catalogued Rapier. Fixed timestep and step() allow deterministic capture; timeStep=vary does not.

notes: 2026-10-26: determinism across runs not tested; npm metadata lists no licence field, MIT taken from the repository page. Borderline on the 12-month maintenance line.
